item.title: Thymeleaf Expression Bypass to SSTI - CVE-2026-40478
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9) — web · CVE-2026-40478 / GHSA-xjw8-8c5c-9r79. Status: PoC. Affects: Thymeleaf (server-side Java template engine), as used by Spring Boot web applications. Tags: Thymeleaf, Spring Boot, SSTI, expression injection, sandbox bypass, CWE-1336, CWE-917, Java, unauthenticated.

item.title: Mautic Theme Template Server-Side Template Injection to RCE (CVE-2026-9558)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — web · CVE-2026-9558 / GHSA-9fx4-7cmj-47vg / CWE-1336. Status: Weaponized (a working malicious theme package plus a documented end-to-end run; exploitation is driven manually through the Mautic UI). Affects: Mautic marketing automation platform, theme engine (Twig templates inside uploaded theme ZIPs). Tags: mautic, twig, ssti, cwe-1336, php, theme-upload, email-builder, rce, privilege-escalation.

item.title: GLPI Form-Tab Callable Injection to Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-26026)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — web · CVE-2026-26026. Status: PoC (complete login-plus-injection chain in a single script, but it needs a pre-existing form record and no successful run is documented). Affects: GLPI asset and IT management suite, server-side item tab renderer (ajax/common.tabs.php) and the Form component templates. Tags: template injection, callable injection, GLPI, PHP, authenticated administrator, RCE, CWE-1336, CWE-94, CSRF.

Tags: RCE, Magento, Adobe Commerce, template-injection, CWE-1336, unauthenticated, GraphQL, directive-injection, BlockStrap, PHP.
